blueberry.definitionKo: 검은 빛깔의 작고 둥근 모양에 달고 신 맛이 나는 열매.
blueberry.englishDescription: A small, black, round-shaped fruit with a sweet and sour taste.

class.englishDescription: The class or scope of things which have common traits.

clover.definitionKo: 가지는 땅으로 길게 뻗으며 거꾸로 된 심장 모양의 잎이 서너 쪽씩 달리고 초여름에 흰 꽃이 피는 풀.
clover.englishDescription: A plant with three or four leaves in reversed heart-shape, whose white flowers bloom in early summer and whose stem spreads widely on the ground.

deciliter.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for measuring the volume of a thing.

filling.definitionKo: 이은 부분이나 틈새에 물이나 공기가 새지 않도록 끼워 넣음. 또는 그런 물건.
filling.englishDescription: An act of putting something inside a joint or crack so that water or air does not leak, or such an object.

milliliter.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of volume.

minuet.definitionKo: 17∼18세기경 유럽에서 추던 3/4박자의 우아하고 약간 빠른 춤.  또는 그 춤곡.
minuet.englishDescription: An elegant, slightly fast dance in three-four time, which was popular in 17th- and 18th-century Europe, or the music itself.

pay.definitionKo: 무대나 영화, 드라마, 광고 등에 출연할 때 계약에 따라 받는 금액.
pay.englishDescription: Signing fee for appearing in a movie, a TV show or a commercial.

siren.definitionKo: 큰 소리를 내어 위급한 상황임을 알리는 장치. 또는 그 소리.
siren.englishDescription: A device that makes a loud sound to send an alert on an urgent situation, or such a sound emitted from the device.

spread.definitionKo: 몹시 화가 나서 눈을 크고 사납게 뜨다.
spread.englishExpression: Double wicks grow[sprout/spread/stand up/soar/rise] in one's eyes
spread.englishDescription: To open one's eyes wide and furiously out of violent anger.

trip.definitionKo: 단체 구성원들이 서로 더 가까워지기 위해 어울려 떠나는 짧은 여행.
trip.englishDescription: An excursion that a group goes on together to foster solidarity or camaraderie.

unwillingly.englishExpression: helplessly; unwillingly; be forced to; be compelled to
